items.title: The qc coverings on the category of locally quasi-compact Hausdorff spaces form a topology

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma verifies the three axioms of a pretopology for the qc coverings on the category LC of Hausdorff locally quasi-compact spaces (statement lines 7524-7538). The non-formal content is in parts (2) and (3), which are finite-refinement arguments: in part (2) one first chooses finitely many quasi-compact E_a whose images cover a neighbourhood of x, then refines each by finitely many quasi-compact F_{e,j}, using quasi-compactness of E_a to cut the e-parameter down to finitely many points (proof lines 7544-7562); in part (3) one pulls back the finite data along the base change and uses a quasi-compact neighbourhood F of x' whose fibre products with the E_j are quasi-compact, with F the image of their coproduct (proof lines 7565-7574). The claim is H2: two explicit finite-refinement constructions after one immediate part.
